Cardinality caps are constant relative to request history, not a formal byte/RSS bound or O(1) per-request time proof. Pruning scans the bounded ledger and ETS copies state. A larger unreconciled historical fixture is preserved rather than silently evicted.
Linked-free guardian survives state-owner crashes, not whole VM death or deliberate guardian kill; ETS is public to trusted same-node BEAM code, not a hostile-code security boundary.
Missing metabolic/POODAVR probes and excluded knowledge paths refuse honestly. Tool route coverage does not prove external backend availability.
